summary.name: coralineai
summary.one_liner: coralineai is a paid, independent fan AI video tool at coralineai.run that turns one adult selfie into a ~10s 9:16 Button Eye Doll style reel.
use_cases: Making a Button Eye Doll trend post for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
Creating a Halloween meme video from a selfie
Friend challenge videos using one photo
Vertical short-form clips without writing a prompt
summary.what_it_does: The page describes uploading one adult face photo (or 1-2 photos) with no prompt needed, then rendering a ~10s 9:16 vertical Halloween-style half-face reel built on a locked template. Renders are 720p for $8.88 (500 credits), with 480p costing 375 credits. Credit packs are one-time purchases via Stripe checkout, and failed renders restore credits. Photos are said to stay local for preview and are not kept as a long-term public gallery; the MP4 download link expires, so the user must save it promptly.
notable: One photo, no prompt: upload a selfie and tap Create
